# p10k-rs v0.1.6 — DRAFT

> Status: **draft** — pending Sean's review. Replace this banner
> and tag when ready. The release workflow fires on
> `git push origin v0.1.6`.

**The pure-Rust git-status fallback release.** When neither the
`gitstatusd` daemon nor a system `git` binary is on `$PATH`, the
prompt now falls back to gitoxide-backed status reporting at full
ShellOut parity: branch name, dirty indicator, and in-progress
action.

Intended user: anyone running a shell in a stripped container.
AI host images (Claude Code, Cursor) routinely drop `git` to save
space; some CI runners do the same. Before v0.1.6 the prompt
would silently lose its VCS indicator in those environments —
now it doesn't.

**Test count:** 544 passing, 3 ignored (537 at v0.1.5).
**Slice count:** 4 code commits since v0.1.5.
**Theme:** "pure-Rust git-status fallback (slice 60)."

## What you'll notice (visible changes)

### VCS prompt works in stripped containers

Drop into a Docker image without `git` installed and you used to
get a degraded prompt — the `vcs` segment silently hid itself
even inside an actual git repo. Now the same cwd shows your
branch and dirty marker the same way it does on a host with a
full git install:

```
~/work/repo on main ✗   # GixBackend kicked in; no git binary needed
```

Branch name, dirty marker (any modification / untracked file /
conflict), and the in-progress action label (merge / rebase /
cherry-pick / revert / bisect) all match what ShellOut would have
reported on a system with `git`. Same vcs segment, same render —
the user doesn't need to know which backend produced the data.

### Field coverage

| Field | gitstatusd | ShellOut | GixBackend (v0.1.6) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `branch` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `dirty` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `action` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `staged` / `unstaged` / `untracked` / `conflicts` counts | ✓ | ✗ | ⏳ v0.1.7 |
| `ahead` / `behind` | ✓ | ✓ (parsed from porcelain) | ⏳ v0.1.7 |

After v0.1.6 GixBackend has the same coverage as ShellOut. The
richer counter / ahead-behind story stays gated to v0.1.7 because
the gix API for those operations needs more probing than fit a
clean v0.1.6 boundary.

### Backend chain order

Unchanged precedence: `gitstatusd → ShellOut → GixBackend`. The
last tier only fires when ShellOut's own `git` invocation returns
empty (typically because `git` isn't on `$PATH` at all). On a
normal host with `git`, GixBackend never runs — no perf hit.

## What you won't notice (but matters)

### Empirical dep-choice flip

The slice-60 design doc recommended scoped gitoxide subcrates
(`gix-discover` + `gix-ref` + `gix-status` + ...) over the full
`gix` umbrella, on the assumption that scoped would cost ~12
transitive packages vs the umbrella's ~50. Empirical research
during v0.1.6 found the scoped subset would actually cost +53
new packages AND require a `gix-hash` feature workaround (its
`Kind` enum has variants gated behind `sha1`/`sha256` features
that downstream doesn't enable, so a transitive-only pull fails
to compile). Umbrella with `default-features = false, features = ["sha1", "status"]`
matches the package count without the workaround and gives a
much cleaner high-level API. Workspace deviates from the design
recommendation on this point — see the gix dep block in the root
`Cargo.toml` for the full rationale.

### Two RUSTSEC advisories closed by the version pin

Pinning `gix = "0.66"` (the design's reference version) triggered:

- **RUSTSEC-2025-0140** — `gix-date 0.9.4`'s `TimeBuf::as_str`
  can produce a non-UTF-8 `String`. Fixed in gix-date ≥ 0.12.
- **RUSTSEC-2025-0021** — `gix-features 0.38` uses `sha1` /
  `sha1_smol` without collision detection (the SHAttered class
  of attacks). Fixed in gix-features versions that switch to
  `sha1-checked`.

Both fixed in gix 0.83+. The workspace pins `=0.83.0` exact so
a transient gitoxide bump can't reintroduce a known-bad version.
`cargo deny check` is clean.

### Render-path sanitisation chokepoint

Every byte the gix backend produces flows through `SafeText`:

- Branch names: `from_untrusted_bytes` (control-byte strip + NFC
  normalisation + grapheme-safe truncation) followed by
  `from_untrusted_with_cap(4 KiB)` for a defensive length ceiling
  against pathological `.git/refs/heads/` names that bypass git's
  own `check-ref-format` rejection.
- Detached-HEAD short OIDs: `from_untrusted` (pure ASCII hex; no
  byte-level sanitisation needed beyond the type-system gate).
- Action labels: reused `crate::detect_action` produces a
  `SafeText` directly.

Same render-path discipline as the existing gitstatusd + ShellOut
backends. No bypass paths.

## How to verify (unchanged from v0.1.5)

Same recipe — every tarball ships with a sigstore keyless
signature plus SLSA build-provenance attestation. After install,
`p10k-rs verify` re-hashes gitstatusd against the committed pin.

```bash
cosign verify-blob \
  --bundle p10k-rs-v0.1.6-<triple>.tar.gz.cosign.bundle \
  --certificate-identity-regexp \
    'https://github.com/scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs/\.github/workflows/release\.ya?ml@refs/tags/v0\.1\.6' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \
  p10k-rs-v0.1.6-<triple>.tar.gz

gh attestation verify p10k-rs-v0.1.6-<triple>.tar.gz \
  --owner scurran1986

p10k-rs verify
```

All must succeed. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Migration

No breaking changes. The new backend tier is transparent — on
any host where gitstatusd or `git` is available, the chain
short-circuits before reaching GixBackend, so behaviour is
byte-identical to v0.1.5.

If your prompt already used to hide the vcs segment because you
were on a host without `git`, that's where you'll see the new
behaviour: the segment now reports state instead of hiding.

## Deferred to v0.1.7

- **Slice 60 phase 3.5** — per-category counts (staged /
  unstaged / untracked / conflicts) from gix's status iterator.
  Needs to discriminate Item variants from the iterator and add
  a second tree-vs-index iterator for the staged count.
- **Slice 60 phase 4** — ahead/behind via gix revwalk. Hit API
  discovery friction; `head_id.ahead_behind(upstream_id)` from
  the design doc doesn't exist on gix 0.83's `Id`. Needs more
  probing.
- **Slice 60 phase 6** — cross-check tests + criterion bench
  against ShellOut on a kernel-class repo.
- **Slice 64** — daemon-respawn / health-check cache (ADR-0001
  § Follow-ups).
